survey.title: CashArt - Collector Survey
survey.subtitle: Takes under 1 minute
survey.description: We're exploring how collectors manage liquidity and financing in the art world. Your feedback will help shape smarter financial solutions for collectors like you.

q1.question: How often do you acquire new artworks?

q2.question: What's the typical price range of the artworks you collect?

q3.question: Have you ever wanted to access liquidity without selling your artworks?

q4.question: What has stopped you from using your art as collateral in the past?

options.possession: Didn't want to give up possession

q5.question: If you could get up to 70% of an artwork's value in cash within a few days (without selling it), how appealing would that be?

q6.question: How important is it for you to keep physical possession of your artworks while accessing liquidity?

q7.question: Would you like to join our private waitlist to be among the first collectors to access this non-custodial art financing service?
